title: Wo taucht der Center auf?
observableEvidence: relative height vs current play (behind / connection / ahead)
spatial side or zone cue without tactical judgment
evaluationFocus: identification without inventing intent or system labels
requiredForStrong: names where the center appeared with a visible cue
keeps claim to this sighting — no team tendency
does not evaluate whether the position was 'good'
commonFailureModes: punishing uncertainty when the learner correctly marks unsure
fairnessNote: Excellent A1 answers may score quality ~0.9. Missing system analysis must not lower quality — difficulty lives in evidenceLevel/maxStrength, not a harsher quality scale.
minimalInputChange: Keep structured shift_tracker quality (already implemented). AI only if a short required note (≥40 chars) is added after scans — not needed for competence evidence.
